youtube_description:
PlayClothes, a vintage thrift shop on Magnolia blvd in Burbank California, is one of my top favorite thrift shops to visit! Despite me walking out empty handed, they have a lot of great stuff for sale! Hopefully you guys enjoy this mini vlog of me showing you the ins and out of this cool place!
